name: EGFR Targeted Therapy
text: EGFR is frequently activated in non-small cell lung cancer and promotes tumor cell proliferation through downstream signaling pathways. Osimertinib targets mutant EGFR and inhibits EGFR signaling. EGFR inhibition reduces proliferation of EGFR-mutant tumor cells.
questions: What disease is EGFR associated with?
What happens when EGFR signaling is inhibited?
